Review rejected: check_wave_open currently permits opening 2026-W26 while current 2026-W25 is still open, because cooldown only considers the latest close event anywhere in history. Add a guard requiring the current/last wave to be closed before opening the successor, plus tests for status=open/no close. Verification run by reviewer: python3 -m pytest tests/orchestrator/test_wave_open_guard.py -q -> 40 passed; python3 -m py_compile .orchestrator/wave_guards.py scripts/ai_status.py tests/orchestrator/test_wave_open_guard.py -> passed; probe reproduced PASS for current-open W25 -> W26.

Re-submitted after review rejection. Added check_current_wave_closed() guard (status=open path + history fallback). check_wave_open now runs it first. 9 new tests; suite 40 → 49.
